evidence: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 FID 78 identifies Veterinary Medicine Isolation Facility (VMIF), at 402 S University Street.
The 12 perimeter vertices of the modeled wall shell match the projected source polygon; maximum XY error is 0.000000939 m.
The Purdue Archives source separately supports VMIF identity and the eight-stall animal-care program.
limits: GIS Shape__Area reports 849.074 m² while the captured ring coordinates produce 491.252 m² under the documented local projection (357.822 m² / 72.8% difference). The model follows the polygon ring and does not reconcile this provider conflict.

evidence: The saved scene anchor matches the source polygon centroid within 0.000000000 m.
The wall outline preserves the official GIS ring shape and rotation without rescaling.
limits: The master placement marker and nearby campus context were not part of this isolated-asset review.
Plinth and fascia extend beyond the source wall perimeter, so the overall mesh bounds are slightly larger than the GIS envelope.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Purdue GIS reports one level, matching the single-storey shell.
Fresh-open local geometry reaches 3.92 m above its origin.
limits: The 3.66 m eave height interprets GIS Extrution=12 as feet although field units are undocumented.
No captured source verifies the flat/low-slope roof form, roof elevation, parapet profile, or HVAC arrangement.

evidence: The outline is distinctive and follows the cross-shaped GIS perimeter; the interior cutaway includes a schematic corridor, eight stalls and support/mechanical rooms consistent with the Archives program description.
limits: The exterior has no modeled windows or entrance doors; the builder explicitly left openings out because target-specific facade evidence was not found.
Wall, roof and trim materials are visual assumptions. The model reads as a generic blank service building in its exterior preview.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Blender 5.2.3 LTS reopened the saved source scene and expected exported collection successfully.
The collection contains 70 local mesh objects with 584 vertices and 416 faces.
Every mesh has a material assigned; there are no external image dependencies or linked libraries.
Structured provenance, builder notes, two preview renders and a fresh-open probe are present.

findings.finding: The GIS Shape__Area value (849.074 m²) conflicts with the area derived from the returned polygon coordinates (491.252 m²). The model exactly follows the vertices, but the source discrepancy remains unresolved.

The exterior shell has no doors or windows and no target-specific facade evidence; the current exterior therefore appears as a generic blank volume. Obtain reliable target-specific facade imagery or plans before adding these details.
The roof form and height are estimates. The 12-unit extrusion is interpreted as feet without documented units. The interior program is evidence-informed, while its spatial layout is illustrative.
This grade covers the standalone asset only; the master placement and overlap with neighboring models were not inspected.
